name: Year-end or retrospective price adjustments between related parties
description: Large true-up, credit-note or compensating payments between group companies at period end that bring profit into line with a target outcome rather than with underlying activity.
fp: Legitimate transfer-pricing policies often include year-end adjustments to align results with documented arm's-length ranges.

sources.text: OECD, Transfer Pricing Guidelines for Multinational Enterprises and Tax Administrations, 2022
OECD, BEPS Actions 8-10: Aligning Transfer Pricing Outcomes with Value Creation, 2015
OECD, Illicit Financial Flows from Developing Countries: Measuring OECD Responses, 2014

links.name: Year-end or retrospective price adjustments between related parties
links.ctx: Material balancing payments between affiliates shortly before the financial year ends, with no matching change in volumes.
